name: test-debrief-synthesizer
description: Synthesizes what really happened across test sessions, part of the Design Thinking Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run test-debrief-synthesizer", "synthesize the test results", "what did the testing tell us", "did the prototype pass", or test sessions are done and the team is about to remember them more fondly than they went. Use it even for "the tests went well, I think".
